coordinatorNotes: The substantive locale-consistency defect is found by both arms. Candidate reviews explicitly diagnose the missing existing-label/list-label coverage; controls recommend tests without describing the current suite gap.

Contact core behavior/reuse findings are present in both arms. Candidate records make the combined target and source-based mechanism rationale more explicit; no review earns a full D1 architecture diagnosis from Carbon.

Carbon says controls did not inspect ContactStore or tests. Native calls show those files were read in both controls; the defensible difference is what the written reviews articulate. Raw judgments are preserved unchanged.

D2 does not require exact helper names or one consolidated paragraph. Parts of Carbon's partial reasoning cite absent normalizeEmail naming or scattered presentation; these are not independent failures. The claimed D2 gap is qualified rather than used as an architectural superiority score.
r05 control uniquely flags the extra rows output. The skill did not dominate every necessity detail.

r08 added planImport to target_units after the checker rejected split without a new target unit. The final recommendation is real, but helper presence alone is not evidence of an independently developed design diagnosis.
limitations: Two reviews per arm per familiar synthetic case; no statistical reliability/equivalence estimate.
One judge per case; output format can reveal the arm.
The treatment includes canonical record production; this is not an isolation of one instruction sentence.
No implementation or new-requirement stage; static recommendations are not code outcomes.
The original private source/contracts packet and its integrity manifest could not be recovered; no substitute was reviewed.
Raw final judge scores and coordinator qualifications are both retained; no hidden adjudicated score.
